items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: They didn't only use a live calliope on the circuses; they used them on some of the riverboats. Like when the steamer Capitol or the Streckfus Line boats that Louis and them played on...

ctx.x: Oh, I know, you can hear them. All over New Orleans today you can hear them.

They didn't only use a live calliope on the circuses; they used them on some of the riverboats. Like when the steamer Capitol or the Streckfus Line boats that Louis and them played on, or the St. Paul or the Steamer Sidney, when they came to Baton Rouge, they'd have excursions going out of Baton Rouge, and the only way you'd know is that they would be in town, and they came town five miles out -- they'd start playing the calliope.
